How Student Learning
Is Assessed on the
AP Exam
Section I: Multiple-Choice
Thefirstsectionof theAPCalculusABandBCExamsincludes 42multiple-
choicequestions.Agraphingcalculatorisrequiredforthefinal 13questions
(Part B).RefertotheTechnologyNeeds and Use of Graphing Calculators section
onp.7foralistofcalculatorcapabilitiesnecessaryfortheAPExam.Boththe
AB and BCExamsincludealgebraic,exponential,logarithmic,trigonometric,
and general types of functions.Both also include analytical, graphical, tabular,
andverbal typesofrepresentations.
Mathematical Practices 1,2,and 3 are assessed in in the multiple-choice section,
withthefollowingexamweighting(Practice4isnotassessed):
